title: centaurea scabiosa subsp. tematinensis
intro: Centaurea scabiosa subsp. tematinensis, commonly known as the mountain scabious, is a plant species belonging to the daisy family (Asteraceae). This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects. The therapeutic actions of Centaurea scabiosa subsp. tematinensis include soothing skin irritations and wounds, as well as exhibiting antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic properties.
